translation.name: Nzuwulai n Sa'avu na̱ Tsishingini na̱ a̱ɗiva̱ a na a ɗangulai a Nzuwulai mu Ufaru

content: Yesu Kristi† Zamawawa† uta̱ ta̱ o uꞌwa u Mogono Da̱wuda diga o ugundo wa Ibrahim.† Apa nda ugeru u tsukaya tsa na wu uta̱i.

content.text: Yakubu† ɗa matsain Yahuza na akapi a̱ muwun ma̱ a̱na̱wu ma̱ yi olobo.
Yahuza† ɗa matsain mpishe Farisa na̱ Zera (Tamar ɗa makuci me le).
(Bashaba ɗa makuci ma̱ Sulemanu, a̱yi ɗa ka na Da̱wuda
Josaya ɗa matsain Jekoniya na̱ muwun ma̱ a̱na̱wu ma̱ yi olobo.
(A mantsa ma ɗaɗa a̱ pura̱i ama a̱ tyo e iɗa ya Babila† tsugbashi.)
Ana a̱ pura̱ nle a̱ tyo Babila, a̱vu Jekoniya matsan Shayatiya.
Meri† ɗa mma va̱ Yesu za na e ɗeyi Kristi Zamawawa.

content: Ala o ugeru wa zuva e reme ta̱ tsukaya kupa na̱ a̱za̱ a̱ na̱shi diga ya Ibrahim a̱ tyo ya̱ Da̱wuda, na̱ tsukaya kupa na̱ a̱za̱ a̱ na̱shi diga a mantsa ma̱ Da̱wuda a̱ tyo mantsa ma na a̱ pura̱ nle a̱ tyo Babila, waru na̱ tsukaya kupa na̱ a̱za̱ a̱ na̱shi diga a mantsa ma na a̱ pura̱ nle a̱ tyo Babila a̱ tyo mantsa ma Zamawawa.
Apa nda ununa a matsain Kristi Zamawawa. Mma va̱ yi eegeɓe a vuma ro ɗa na a̱ tsu ɗe Isuhu. Babu u reve vali, a̱vu u tsura̱ a̱a̱tsuma̱ o ure wa̱ Ruhu va Akiza.†
Isuhu gba vuma va̱ a̱ɓula̱ ɗa za na shi a yuwusan ili i na i ri mejege; agba u ciga u ca Meri wono a alanga e eteshe shi, ɗaɗa u foɓoi wu kasa na̱ a̱yi usokowu.

A̱yi a̱tsuma̱ a majiyan mo ndolo, a̱vu malingata ma̱ A̱sulazuva ma̱ ta̱wa̱ ya̱ꞌa̱ yi a̱tsuma̱ a alavu, reve u damma, “Isuhu, mawun ma tsukaya ma̱ Da̱wuda, she vu uwwa wovon na vaa zuwa Meri wan, adama a na Ruhu va Akiza ɗa zuwa niyi u yuwain a̱a̱tsuma̱ a mawuꞌun.
U ta matsan ulobo, a̱vu vu ca yi aala Yesu,
† adama a na u ta wawa ama a̱ yi o unusu u le.”
Ne ɗa nzuwulai ma̱ A̱sulazuva n shiwain, ununa Ishaya vumava̱sula̱† dammai ɗe nu ujimu,

content.text: “Usheli u na koto u revei vali shi u ta yuwan a̱a̱tsuma̱, u ta matsan ulobo, reve a ca yi aala Imanuwe.” Urevu wa̱ yi a̱yi ɗa, “A̱sula̱ oɓolo na̱ a̱tsu.”

content: Ana Isuhu jiwain, reve u yuwan ili i na malingata ma̱ A̱sulazuva ma damma niyi u yuwan. A̱vu u tara Meri a̱ tyo o uꞌwa wo oꞌwo ka va̱ yi,
agba e revelei shi hali u matsan uloboꞌo. Reve Isuhu ca yi aala Yesu.

footnotes.text: Da̱wuda yuwan ta̱ tsipere na̱ Bashaba a̱yi o oluso Uriya, reve u yuwan ifoɓi i na vali va̱ yi Uriya a̱a̱ kuwa̱. Aalabari a nda a̱ ta̱ pe a̱tsuma̱ 2 Sam. 11:1-27.
Aala “Yesu” ta̱ nu urevu “A̱sulazuva za vi iwawi.”
